strict_common_support: identical intersection across raw, H4, canonical geometry_v1 and all compared seed checkpoints
primary_choice: eligible budget with lowest three-seed mean D2 validation EPE
parsimony_rule: compare selected budget to each smaller eligible budget with paired frame/sequence bootstrap; if the predeclared 95% interval does not establish positive improvement, choose the smaller budget

bootstrap.resampling_unit: paired sequence then frame within sequence
